## Where the method comes from {-}

We did not invent the method in this book.

- It follows, chapter by chapter, the structure of [***EasyPeasy***](https://easypeasymethod.org/) by **Hackauthor²** (CC BY-SA 4.0), the free hackbook on quitting pornography. The Little Monster, the Big Monster and the order of the chapters are all inherited from it. The wording here is new.
- EasyPeasy is in turn based on **Allen Carr's Easyway** method, first set out in *The Easy Way to Stop Smoking*.

The credit for the method belongs to them. The mistakes in applying it to this habit are ours.

**This book is not affiliated with, authorised by or endorsed by EasyPeasy, Hackauthor², Allen Carr's Easyway or any organisation connected with them.** "Easyway" is their name and we make no claim on it.

## Scripture {-}

Bible quotations are from the **World English Bible (WEB)**, which is in the public domain.

## Quotations {-}

Short quotations from other writers, speakers and forum users remain the property of their authors and are not covered by this book's licence. They are quoted briefly, for comment, with the source noted in each chapter's file. Forum users have been left anonymous in the text.

The text mostly says "one coach" or "one pastor" so that the reader isn't sent chasing names. The credit belongs here. Among those quoted or drawn on most: Augustine, John Owen, Thomas Chalmers, C.S. Lewis, John Piper, Tim Challies, Jason Evert, Craig Groeschel, Mike Novotny, Ezekiel of We Need to Talk, Dr Doug Weiss, Bismarck Ebiweh (FitXFearless), Captain Sinbad, QuitByHealing, Nick Jones, Phineas 808, and many unnamed men and women on the NoFap forum, Reddit, YouTube and the Covenant Eyes blog. The Appendix lists where to find them. Being quoted here doesn't mean any of them endorses this book.

If you are quoted here and would like your words removed or corrected, please say so and it will be done.
